name: summarizer
description: A small JSON-format suite showing that summaries stay on-topic and within budget.

cases.description: The summary must retain the key entities.

input.prompt:
Summarize the release notes.
echo: The 2.0 release adds SSO login, a redesigned dashboard, and faster search.

cases.description: The summary must not invent pricing claims.

input.prompt:
Summarize the announcement.
echo: We launched a new mobile app for all existing customers.

cases.description: The summary should be semantically close to the gold summary.

input.prompt:
Summarize.
echo: The quarterly report shows revenue growth driven by enterprise customers.

cases.expected: Revenue grew this quarter, mainly because of enterprise customers.
